profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Experienced Senior Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the information technology and services industry. Skilled in Search Engine Optimization (SEO), PHP, Web Design, HTML, and Front-end Development. 

You can check my Fiverr profile for small gigs:
https://www.fiverr.com/mam_solutions

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and supported web applications for new and existing clients, delivering technical assistance, estimations, and PHP training sessions. Served as a PHP Subject Matter Expert, consistently earning strong KRA ratings and positive client feedback. Acted as lead developer on several projects, ensuring timely delivery and successful completion.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description: Developed the Camaya Coast Booking Engine using AngularJS and Laravel, and provided on-site technical support during deployment. Successfully launched the system into production for hotel POS use and integrated PayPal as the payment solution.

positions.title: Senior PHP Developer
positions.description: You led the migration of Animaticsmedia, Storyboards, and IAS websites from Microsoft’s .NET framework to an open-source stack using PHP and AWS/Linux, modernizing the infrastructure for better scalability. During this transition, you provided technical support to artists and animators, ensuring their creative workflows remained uninterrupted. You also trained in-house developers on PHP with Laravel 5, equipping them to manage and extend the new system.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Developed and maintained web applications for clients in Australia and New Zealand, supporting feature and support tasks on Plantminer’s system using Kanban methodology.

positions.title: Sr. Web Developer
positions.description: * API Programming and web application development for GPRS related companies

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description: Handled the development of a GPRS system and created necessary endpoints, while also managing the migration of payment logic using CodeIgniter 3.

company.name: Global PInoy Remittance and Services, Inc.

positions.title: Project Lead Developer
positions.description: Worked on the Visual-Eyes web system and its technical support via API integration, while leading the development of eyetracker.ca. Provided PHP and system training to junior members, handled most feature development during sprints, and served as Head of Development in Manila until 2014.

positions.title: Sr, Web Developer / Web Development Head (PH)
positions.description:
* Handles Online Integration via Web to meet client's standards.
* Uses AJAX, JQuery and PHP for backend and HTML5 and CSS3 for front-end.
* Uses OAuth2 Architecture
* Conduct trainings for development.
* With experience to Project Management using SCRUM

positions.locationName: Suite 208 EGI Condominium P. Medina St. cor. Roosevelt St. Brgy. Pio del Pilar,
positions.description:
Welcome to RCD LAND, INC.!!!

Our company is in the real estate business since August 16, 1987 initially as a Real Estate Broker, then as a Housing Contractor and eventually as a Real Estate Developer.

Our mission is to help every Filipino realize his dream by providing him quality yet affordable residential house that is comparable to world

Our experience of selling to thousands of real estate buyers in the last two decades has made us a very firm believer of the fact that satisfied customers provide us with solid reputation that sustained our growth.

As a company policy, therefore, CUSTOMER SATISFACTION is a priority in our order of business.


Job Description: Jr. Programmer

* Manages back-end code in web or desktop
* Manages database applications in MIcrosoft Dynamics NAV
* Handles computer troubleshooting in every department.
* Implemented the NComputing Virtual Desktops
